Count divisible by at least one of 6, 10, or 15:

\[
\lfloor 8000/6\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/10\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/15\rfloor
-3\lfloor 8000/30\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/30\rfloor
=1333+800+533-3(266)+266=2134
\]

Count of those also divisible by 13:

\[
\lfloor 8000/78\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/130\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/195\rfloor
-3\lfloor 8000/390\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/390\rfloor
=102+61+41-3(20)+20=164
\]

So the required count is:

\[
2134-164=1970
\]

FINAL: 1970
